text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 60 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea near 16.5s/151.0e, and nearly stationary. Little change in strength or little movement is expected during the next 36 hours. Justin will threaten shipping through the period as seas in the region will continue quite rough.

Tropical Cyclone Gavin, with 50 mph winds, is near 35s/177e, moving south southwest at 9 mph. Gavin is becoming extratropical at this time. It is expected to track just east of the north island of New Zealand as an extratropical storm system during the next 24 hours. This system is of some concern to shipping in the region due to rough seas and brisk winds.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
